newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean banks to reopen facilities with Hanbo.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean banks to reopen facilities with Hanbo.

text.p: South Korean creditor banks of insolvent Hanbo Steel Co will reopen overdraft facilities with the steelmaker, their spokesman said on Friday.
"Deals with Hanbo Steel through overdraft facilities will resume either tomorrow or on Monday," the spokesman told Reuters.
The creditors' decision follows a Seoul court's decision to freeze Hanbo Steel's assets, pending a ruling on the company's request for court receivership.
Hanbo Steel, South Korea's second largest steelmaker, defaulted on debt repayments last week after piling up five trillion won in loans from banks and financial institutions.
A group of 61 creditors have said they will support receivership by suspending demands for debt repayments.
